avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces atorvastatin plasma levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal products

avoid_supplements.name: Red Yeast Rice
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Contains statin-like compounds (monacolin K) causing additive LDL reduction and myopathy risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue red yeast rice; do not combine with atorvastatin

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Niacin (>2g daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive statin effects increase myopathy, myositis, and rhabdomyolysis risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose niacin; monitor CK levels if low-dose used

caution_supplements.name: Coenzyme Q10 (CoQ10)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Statins deplete CoQ10; supplementation may reduce statin-induced myopathy symptoms
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for muscle pain; CoQ10 100-200mg daily may be considered if myalgias develop

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: Statins may reduce vitamin D synthesis; supplementation supports bone health
caution_supplements.action: Monitor 25-OH vitamin D levels; supplement if deficient (1000-2000 IU daily)

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive cardiovascular benefits; no direct interaction but potentiates anticoagulant effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for bleeding signs if on concurrent anticoagulants; generally safe at standard doses

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit Juice (High volume, >1 liter daily)
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 and OATP1B1 inhibition increases atorvastatin plasma levels up to 16-fold, elevating myopathy risk
avoid_foods.action: Avoid grapefruit juice entirely; select alternative citrus beverages

caution_foods.name: High-fat foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly increase atorvastatin absorption; can reduce drug efficacy for lipid management if diet high in saturated fat
caution_foods.action: Maintain heart-healthy diet low in saturated fat (<7% of calories); take atorvastatin independent of meals

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (>2 drinks daily)
caution_foods.mechanism: Chronic heavy alcohol increases liver enzyme activity and myopathy risk
caution_foods.action: Limit alcohol to ≤1-2 drinks daily; monitor liver function tests

monitoring_notes: Monitor CK and liver function tests (AST, ALT) at baseline and as clinically indicated. Counsel patients on muscle pain/weakness symptoms and the critical importance of avoiding grapefruit products.
